notes: New goal: spells + main attacks together. It counts the spell rotation your mana keeps up, with main attacks in the time between casts, so builds that weave M1s between spells are judged fairly. Pick "Spells + main attacks together" in the form or ask the bot. This is the helper's own estimate (Wynnbuilder has no such number). The report also points it out when it beats spells alone and main attacks alone.
